title: B200 queuing was observed on Oct 29
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

See original issue and comment: https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/166519 and moving the comment over here: 

For B200 linux.dgx.b200.8 queueing, it was caused by me restarting the distributed tests: https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/actions/runs/18869231160/job/53940331137
Need to look into why these distributed tests are running for more than 9 hours - they normally finish within 6 hours. With that said, we need to look into optimizing this 6hours metric - what tests are useful for these distributed jobs?
Update: looks like this issue is mainly ROCm, I will create a new issue for discussion on B200 related stuff.

### Versions

TOT pytorch distributed and infra

cc @ptrblck @msaroufim @eqy @jerryzh168 @seemethere @malfet @pytorch/pytorch-dev-infra
